overall_notes: This paper focuses on temporal commonsense reasoning evaluation in dialogs, not NLG evaluation. The NLG aspect is minimal - models are evaluated on selecting temporal expressions to fill masked spans, which is more of a comprehension/selection task than generation. The paper does not conduct human evaluation of model outputs, only uses human performance as a benchmark. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed minor normalization.
